Cm.interpretation: Tiny archived numerical moment residues with very small printed-unit gates; retain every strict failure separately from material lift/drag discrepancies.

findings: No obvious wrapper axis/column/section-parameter mapping error is established. Literal source alpha 12.5 is zero-lift-line incidence, not geometric pitch or an extra flap deflection.
Material CL/CD/CDi differences grow near ground and for flap loads. N100-to-N200 changes are orders of magnitude below the largest archival discrepancies.

All current near-field circulation drag and Trefftz CDi agree to floating arithmetic in this flat, wind-parallel reconstruction. Archived close-ground no-flap CD is below its own CDi at 25 of 85 rows; raw CD-CDi cannot be interpreted as a nonnegative profile coefficient or silently replaced with .01+CDi.
The close-ground pre-stall drag difference already exists at no-flap alpha 8 while saved post-stall pressure CD is 2.36e-11, so disabling that term alone cannot resolve the systematic difference.

The report records post-stall drag deactivation and the driver preserves one F toggle with unknown prior state; these are source-supported unresolved setup branches. Saved data alone cannot assign the generating settings.
Historical Euler pose is unresolved. Current wind-parallel pose is explicit and internally consistent; missing historical pose does not prove wrong pose.

Stall flags have different established meanings: archived S is retained; current bool means local cl exceeds literal limit. Soft leakage can create post-stall pressure before this bool. Do not equate them or infer a unique stall-law bug.
Current force identities and prior algebra audit establish internal consistency, not ASWING operator parity.
next_discriminatory_work: Use the saved no-flap alpha 8 h/c=.5 versus h=1000 pair for source-level image/force-velocity and influence-state comparison before new numerical work. Recover historical Euler/F/post-stall state if possible; keep each alternative separately declared. Do not fit pose, modify flap constants, replace raw CD, or loosen printed-token gates.
